message.content:
The cost of renting an apartment in New York varies widely depending on the borough, neighborhood, size, and amenities. As of early 2024:

| Area | Typical Monthly Rent (1‑bedroom) |
|------|----------------------------------|
| Manhattan (mid‑town, mid‑range) | $3,200–$4,500 |
| Brooklyn (Williamsburg, Bushwick) | $2,400–$3,800 |
| Queens (Astoria, Long Island City) | $2,000–$3,200 |
| Bronx (Fordham, Riverdale) | $1,600–$2,400 |
| Staten Island (St. George) | $1,400–$2,200 |

These figures are averages; luxury apartments can exceed $10,000/month, while older or smaller units may fall below $1,200. Prices also fluctuate with market demand, so checking current listings on sites like Zillow, StreetEasy, or local real‑estate agents will give you the most accurate, up‑to‑date numbers.
